Two travelers asked the same guard the same question. They got opposite answers.

Kevin explains an ancient story about a man at a city gate. The guard asks what people were like in the city he left. One traveler says horrible people. The next says wonderful people. Each is told he will find the same kind of people here.

Kevin's takeaway is that you create the life you want wherever you go.

What do you expect to find in the people around you?

#ad #mindset #happiness #kevintrudeau

Trying to work out the how can blind you to a good idea.

Kevin explains that most people are not open. They try to figure out the how in advance, and that puts a huge limit on what is possible.

He says that is why many miss big ideas when they first appear. He recalls bumping into Jeff Bezos, who was launching a book thing online, and thinking this guy is a winner.

What idea did you dismiss too quickly?
